ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Science-Fiction-Experience: Undoing Space & Time. This course will examine some of the processes that have standardized and governed our experiences of space and time as well as practices that violate and resist that governance. We will read texts, watch films, and participate in exercises that borrow from a broad sampling of the Humanities and Social Sciences, Science Fiction, Creative Nonfiction, Contemporary Art, and other discursive and practice-based forms. The seminar format will privilege group discussions and activities, while outcomes will draw from individual students’ areas of study and could include written papers, video essays, creative visual/performance projects, and conceptual designs. Undergraduate section. Seats are restricted to A&D majors.
